或許是史上第一首結合挪威文與中文的電子流行歌曲。 兩種來自世界兩端的語言，交織成同一首歌。 LÜCY 的歌聲一步步將你帶入故事深處，而 Moyka 空靈飄渺的嗓音則如同遠方傳來的訊號，在其中若隱若現。貫穿始終的節拍，從未停下腳步。 這是一首關於我們所背負的一切、所承襲的一切，以及那些不斷重複、直到我們鼓起勇氣放手才能真正終結的循環。 我們，能打破這個循環嗎？ I was born into a circle drawn long before my name. I carried all their sorrow, mistaking it for fate. But what was passed down to me does not have to pass through me. The warmth that courses through my blood, in this fleeting moment, let the plague burn within my heart, through every day and every night. ♾️ Lyricist｜LÜCY, Moyka Composer｜LÜCY, Moyka, Eirik Hella Producer｜LÜCY, Moyka, Eirik Hella Arranger｜Eirik Hella Recording Engineer｜Eirik Hella, LÜCY Mixing Engineer｜Eirik Hella Mastering Engineer｜George Tanderø Cover Design｜lalo' maya' titiyon
